message: 新たな任務と責務

name: Synn
message: 「It's a bit late to realize this, but demons who seriously oppose us are actually pretty strong...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting stronger out of nowhere is cheating.」

name: Misa
message: 「We've been winning smoothly lately, so I let my guard down.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those guys yesterday were like an army...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Their movements were well-trained.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sister, have you ever encountered demons like the ones last night? Do demons have armies or anything like that?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry... The Kujou family has never fought that type of demon, so I can't offer any advice or information.」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh? What's wrong with everyone? You all look down.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A little, yeah.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm. That's kinda boring.」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh, right, Sally! Do demons have armies or anything like that?」

name: Sally
message: 「Giving orders and taking orders is such a pain.」

name: Ria
message: 「What about you and Eauderourke, Sally?」

name: Sally
message: 「Boss and I just get along well. Boss has never ordered me to do anything, either. Boss just happens to be stronger and more reliable.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aren't there any among the Seven Demon Generals who have a lot of subordinates?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah, come to think of it, I heard there's one who travels in a pack, though I don't really know much about them.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are completely unreliable, Miss Tag-along.」

name: Sally
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eauderourke's a good guy, though he seems clueless about that sort of thing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Thinking about it forever won't get us anywhere. They won't wait for us, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right!」

name: Misa
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden?」

name: Synn
message: 「They've never waited for us before.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaddaya mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「Up until now, we've always gone in completely blind. We've hardly ever fought an enemy knowing how strong they were beforehand.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it... we really haven't ever fought knowing the enemy's strength in advance.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry I couldn't provide any intel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief, what wonderfully reckless people you are.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're one of us too.」

name: Sally
message: 「Everyone's such an idiot~」

name: Misa
message: 「And what does that make you, Sally, considering you lost to those very idiots?」

name: Sally
message: 「We're buddies now, so it doesn't matter~」

name: Synn
message: 「In other words, our situation hasn't changed at all from before.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I get it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, on the contrary, things are even better than before.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? What are you talking about!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean that we've gotten stronger. If we were still the way we were when we first started the Crusaders, we wouldn't have won yesterday, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right. We really have gotten stronger.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course we have. Losing to my past self would be an utter disgrace.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa's right. We don't need to worry about being stronger than the enemy--we just need to make sure our tomorrow selves are stronger than we are today.」

name: Synn
message: 「We weren't really conscious of it before, but if we keep that in mind from now on, we'll get stronger in no time!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! It feels like the President is saying something really wise. Let's give him one pomelo.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pomelo?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't you mean a floor cushion?」
Yeah. It's everyone, same as always.

name: Azel
message: 「Textbook spiritualism.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Talk about not reading the room.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Classic Azel.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehehe. It's not just wishful thinking, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis! Under the desk again!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um. What's with the gas mask in your hand?」

name: Helena
message: 「I thought everyone might be feeling down, so I was getting ready to fill the room with laughing gas, though that turned out to be a waste.」

name: Misa
message: 「What were you planning to accomplish by forcing us to cheer up!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fortune comes in by a merry gate, as they say. Which means you all need to laugh in the corner of the room.」

name: Helena
message: 「You're all looking great. Just what I'd expect from the Student Council members I trust so much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That would've been a great line if not for what you said a moment ago.」

name: Helena
message: 「All you have to do is become stronger today than you were yesterday. That solves the problem.」

name: Azel
message: 「Illogical. That doesn't guarantee we can defeat the enemy.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not true. We are certainly weaker than the Demons.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jumping straight to the conclusion!?」

name: Helena
message: 「However. That very strength is the Demons' weakness.」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Helena
message: 「Because Demons are inherently strong and have long lifespans, their rate of growth is terribly slow. Humans, on the other hand, grow quickly. In other words.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we're evenly matched right now, we'll overtake them in no time?」

name: Helena
message: 「That is the power of humans.」

name: Azel
message: 「Without a concrete method to improve our abilities, that's still just wishful thinking.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. If you follow this special training regimen, lo and behold. You just might get super strong compared to our previous models?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis... why do you always phrase things so awkwardly?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And as a question, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you make this, Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a secret. The more mysteries a woman has, the better she is.」
She's an unfathomable person.

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, once again. I hereby order the Ryuusei Crusaders to undertake intensive anti-Demon combat training and regular patrol duties.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes, ma'am!」

name: Helena
message: 「We'll support you as much as we can, too. Ultimately, though, we're counting on you all. Do your best. I've even called in an instructor.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh. That's even more reassuring.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, Sally-chan. I leave the rest to you.」

name: Sally
message: 「OK. BOSS.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Eeeh!?」
